item.title: Kansas House and Senate pass bill that polices bathrooms in public buildings
item.description: On Jan. 28, the Kansas Legislature approved Senate Bill 244 that would effectively outlaw individuals using bathrooms and identification, like a driver’s license, that doesn’t align with their sex at birth.
